questions.prompt: How does this chapter mainly redefine rationality?
choices: As formal elegance above all else
As what survives consequence and avoids ruin
As whatever sounds most consistent in debate

explanation.gentle: The chapter ties rationality to survival under real consequence.
explanation.direct: Taleb treats endurance and ruin-avoidance as stronger tests than neat theory alone.
explanation.competitive: If it blows you up, it was not rational enough.

questions.prompt: Why does revealed preference matter in this chapter?
choices: Because what people do under exposure can reveal practical rationality
Because theory is always useless
Because consistency never matters

explanation.gentle: Action under pressure can reveal more than verbal reasoning alone.
explanation.direct: Taleb uses behavior under consequence as evidence of what actually works.
explanation.competitive: Watch the move under stress, not the lecture in safety.

questions.prompt: What makes a polished theory weak under Taleb’s test?
choices: If it flatters logic while leaving the agent fragile
If it is mathematically precise
If it is hard to explain

explanation.gentle: The problem is fragility under consequence, not precision itself.
explanation.direct: A theory loses rank when elegance outruns survival value.
explanation.competitive: Beautiful logic that makes you brittle is a trap.

questions.prompt: A messy heuristic keeps someone out of ruin while a cleaner model increases downside exposure. What would Chapter 18 emphasize?
choices: The cleaner model is automatically more rational
The heuristic may be more rational because it preserves survival
Neither approach can be judged

explanation.gentle: The chapter prioritizes what keeps the agent intact.
explanation.direct: Survival value can outrank formal neatness under asymmetry.
explanation.competitive: The uglier rule just beat the prettier coffin.

questions.prompt: How does this chapter connect to the rest of the book?
choices: It applies the same skin-in-the-game realism test to rationality itself
It abandons asymmetry and ruin concerns
It argues that theory should always be ignored

explanation.gentle: The same realism test now governs judgments about reason.
explanation.direct: Rationality joins other domains that must answer to consequence.
explanation.competitive: Now abstract reason gets dragged into the downside audit too.

questions.prompt: Why does Taleb care about bounded rationality here?
choices: Because agents make choices under limited knowledge and asymmetric risk
Because limits make all reasoning irrational
Because bounded rationality removes the need for judgment

explanation.gentle: Real agents reason under constraint, not from perfect knowledge.
explanation.direct: Bounded rationality matters because survival occurs under incomplete information.
explanation.competitive: You reason in the fog, not in the textbook vacuum.

questions.prompt: Why is this chapter not an attack on logic itself?
choices: Because the target is detached elegance that fails reality, not reasoning as such
Because contradiction is always acceptable
Because every habit counts as rational

explanation.gentle: The chapter wants a stricter reality test, not the end of thought.
explanation.direct: Taleb is attacking fragility disguised as reason, not reason itself.
explanation.competitive: He is humiliating brittle cleverness, not banning thinking.

questions.prompt: What stronger question should a reader ask before praising a theory as rational?
choices: Does it sound elegant?
Does it help an agent survive and stay intact under exposure?
Does it win academic approval?

explanation.gentle: The stronger question is about consequence-tested survival.
explanation.direct: Taleb wants rationality checked against operational endurance.
explanation.competitive: Ask whether it keeps you alive before admiring the symmetry.

questions.prompt: What is the deeper lesson of Chapter 18?
choices: Real rationality is operational and consequence-tested rather than merely elegant
Only theory matters for sound judgment
Every survival strategy is automatically wise

explanation.gentle: The chapter points to rationality shown through survival and action.
explanation.direct: Operational endurance is stronger evidence than abstract neatness alone.
explanation.competitive: The rational move is the one that still exists after pressure.

questions.prompt: Which sentence best captures the chapter’s lesson?
choices: Rationality belongs to the cleanest-looking theory
What keeps agents intact under real consequence deserves more credit than formal polish alone
Messiness is always superior to rigor

explanation.gentle: The chapter ties rationality to consequence-tested survival.
explanation.direct: Taleb upgrades what works under exposure over what only looks tidy.
explanation.competitive: If pressure kills the model, stop worshipping its elegance.
